item.title: 2025 Peggy Hughes Summer Concert Series
item.description: The Town of Ocean Isle Beach Recreation Department has announced the Peggy Hughes Summer Concert Series lineup for 2025. All events will take place at Town Center Park in Ocean Isle Beach, North Carolina and they will run from 6:30 - 8:00PM. For more information we encourage you to visit their website. All concerts are free and chair set-up after 4PM. May 25th - Main Event Band June 6th - Christine Martinez June 13th - The Entertainers June 20th - The Tonez June 27th - Blackwater Band June 30th
